description: The file 'SystemAudioPlayer.h' is a C++ header defining the interface for the SystemAudioPlayer plugin class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations, interface implementations, method signatures for controlling audio playback, event notifications, and plugin lifecycle management.
